prompt: Review an unseen integration landscape and design its synchronous API, asynchronous event and webhook reliability contracts. After the first review, adapt when one major timing, scale, privacy, compatibility or recovery constraint changes. Use only reviewer-owned sanitized offline artifacts.
deliverables: User operations timing correctness and coupling requirements.
Component state-ownership trust and failure-domain map.
Request response deadline idempotency error and long-running-operation contract.
Event notification versus event-carried-state decision and envelope.
Producer publication and consumer effect transaction boundaries.
Schema identity compatibility deprecation and old/new test matrix.
Partition ordering duplicate checkpoint poison replay and retention policy.
Webhook signature freshness authorization delivery claim and acknowledgment design.
Retry queue concurrency burst observability privacy security and cost envelope.
Incident recovery changed-constraint decision alternatives and cleanup proof.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unfamiliar contracts and changes one major constraint after the first design.
No credential live endpoint broker webhook cloud resource customer data or production mutation.
Every acknowledgement states exactly what durable fact it means.
Every duplicate and ambiguous boundary has identity owner and reconciliation.
Compatibility is tested across actual producer and consumer versions, not inferred from additive syntax.
Ordering scope and partition-key consequence are explicit.
Replay distinguishes rebuilding derived state from repeating external effects.
Webhook verification preserves provider-defined raw material and adds freshness plus durable delivery claim.
Reviewer observes changed-constraint reasoning delayed recall safety and cleanup.
